relevance.rationale: Identity confirmed from the document's own cover (arXiv:math/0104104v3 [math.DG], geometry of four-vector fields on quaternionic flag manifolds, two authors) and matches the seeded key. Single citation site, and it IS load-bearing and correct: folio/quantum-observable-universe/bring_tetraplectic.md:53 writes 'Following Foth-Leitner for quaternionic flag manifolds, the Reeb triad is generated by the quaternionic operators M_x (x in {i,j,k}), which we model as right-multiplication by the imaginary units on H', and displays M_x = [[x,0],[0,x]]. VERIFIED in the source: the document defines M_x = diag(x, x) for x in {i,j,k} alongside S_x and H_x, sets M_{-x} := -M_x, and derives the commutator relations [M_x, E] = 0 and [M_x, M_y] = 2 M_{x.y} (0 when x = y). That is precisely the operator family and the quaternionic-twist bracket the block reuses. Caveat recorded honestly: the document has zero occurrences of 'Reeb', '3-Sasakian' or 'right multiplication' — the Reeb-triad and 3-Sasakian framing is the folio's own transport of the construction, and the block's 'Following ...' wording correctly signals that rather than attributing the framing to the source.

keyResults.locator: §2, definitions of S_x, H_x, M_x and the commutator table
keyResults.statement: The 2x2 quaternionic operators M_x = diag(x,x), H_x, S_x for x in {i,j,k} satisfy [M_x, E] = 0, [H_x, E] = 2 S_x, [S_x, E] = 2 H_x, and [M_x, M_y] = [H_x, H_y] = [S_x, S_y] = 2 M_{x.y} (zero when x = y).
keyResults.useForFolio: It is the algebraic backbone of the tetraplectic Reeb-triad construction in bring_tetraplectic — the quaternionic twist 'flowing along M_i rotates the complementary structures into one another' is the [M_x, M_y] = 2 M_{x.y} relation.
